label: Fluid
description: A fluid stirred by wandering jets: coloured dye, or particles drifting on the flow

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Dye, particles, or both in turn

secs.label: Cycle
secs.description: Seconds before the fluid starts again with new colours (and for particles a new density), and in all the next mode

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: A black bar along the bottom naming what is showing, with a live figure, in LED lettering
